documentTitle: CFD Corrective Action Plan & Implementation Record

remediations.actionTitle: Turbulence Scheme & Flow Regime Dynamic Routing
remediations.description: Replaced hardcoded 'K_EPSILON' with dynamic routing from caseDef.turbulenceModelIdentity and caseDef.flowRegime. Automatically routes LAMINAR (useTurbulenceModel: false) and SST_K_OMEGA (turbulenceScheme: 'SST_K_OMEGA'), defaulting to K_EPSILON.
remediations.regressionSafeguards: Backwards-compatible; default cases without explicit model identity continue to use K_EPSILON with identical behavior.

remediations.actionTitle: Generalized Scalar Grid Convergence Contract in GciEngine
remediations.description: Implemented GciEngine.evaluateScalarContract to calculate Richardson extrapolation and ASME V&V 20 GCI over arbitrary engineering scalar fields (pressure drop, drag coefficient, mass imbalance, etc.) avoiding divide-by-zero on symmetric lift-neutral cases.
remediations.regressionSafeguards: Existing evaluateStrictContract method remains intact for backwards compatibility.

remediations.actionTitle: Automated Analytical Poiseuille Flow Benchmark Verification
remediations.description: Implemented automated analytical benchmark runner comparing FVM discrete velocity profiles with exact Hagen-Poiseuille parabolic solution u(y) = 4*umax*(y/H)*(1 - y/H), verifying relative L2 error <= 5.0%.
remediations.regressionSafeguards: Executed as an isolated test case in the acceptance pipeline.

zeroWeakeningCertification: No thresholds, assertions, convergence tolerances, or fail-closed abort rules were softened or removed.
